title: Origin story: Shiva
description: Shiva is the ascetic god of the Himalayas, third of the Trimurti, who dances the universe into and out of existence. He drank the poison churned from the ocean to save creation, holding it in his throat — hence his blue neck — and granted the Ganges passage through his matted hair.

title: Ability profile: Shiva
description: Ranked abilities: Cosmic dance — rank 100/100; Ascetic power — rank 100/100; Destruction — rank 100/100; Yoga mastery — rank 99/100; Compassion — rank 95/100.

title: Power ranking: Shiva
description: Powers: The third eye, whose glance incinerates; The damru drum beating time itself; The trishul trident ordering three worlds.

title: Stamina feats: Shiva
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Meditated for eons unmoving; Holds the poison of the cosmos in his throat forever.

title: Crossover notes: Shiva
description: Shiva crosses naturally with: destruction, dance, asceticism, renewal.

title: Cultural impact: Shiva
description: Nataraja, the dancing lord, is among the most profound images in world art.
